_doc: Where a vote weighs most (pipeline/peso_voto.py). Per province and family: p = share of draws of Nuestra predicción in which 1000 more votes for its list win it one more seat (D'Hondt, 3% threshold), a = the same split by the family that loses that seat, v = median vote share, k = its next seat (the first won in under half the draws); e = p, a and k in each third of the draws by the national lead of the left over the right (e[0] worst for the left, e[2] best). A description of the forecast, not advice.
